asked.item: Why the TikTok video is muted after Blotato posts it
Song plays when uploaded manually in the app

verdict.reason: The TikTok muted-video FAQ explains the cause for Business accounts and gives the fix.

steps.text: Blotato does not mute your video. TikTok mutes it on their end when their system detects copyrighted or commercially licensed music in the audio.

TikTok Business accounts are limited to TikTok's Commercial Music Library, and music from outside that library is the usual reason an API-posted video gets muted, even when the same file uploads fine in the TikTok app.
Replace the audio with a track from TikTok's Commercial Music Library, or use original audio you own.
Re-export the video with the cleared audio, then publish again from Blotato.
